texts.at-0001: Convert prices with to_money, never float Always normalize monetary inputs through `ledgerly.money.to_money` (and compare against `ZERO`) before storing them on models; never accept raw floats as prices.
texts.at-0002: Raise BillingError with snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, matching `ledgerly/payments.py`.
texts.at-0003: Exclude bool when validating integers When validating an integer argument, reject `bool` explicitly (`isinstance(x, bool) or not isinstance(x, int)`) because `True`/`False` pass `isinstance(..., int)`.
texts.at-0004: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
texts.at-0005: Money operations accept idempotency_key and check it first Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before validating state: if `ledgerly.audit.events()` has an entry with that key, return the origina
texts.at-0006: Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and `approved_by` is missing; amounts at or b

item.title: Use Decimal and ROUND_HALF_UP for money
item.content: Compute monetary results in ledgerly with Decimal(str(value)) and quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) rather than float arithmetic, and reject non-finite values.
